what.text: The company is a bank that provides a range of financial solutions to large corporates, mid-market companies, MSMEs, and retail customers. It combines a strong portfolio with customer insights to deliver its services.

segments.name: Small and Mid-Market
segments.text: This segment focuses on MSME lending and is a key growth engine for the bank. It ranks among the top three MSME lenders in 25 states.

segments.name: Investment Banking
segments.text: The bank offers capital finance through debt/equity capital markets, mergers and acquisitions, and customized solutions.

segments.name: Digital and Technology
segments.text: The bank emphasizes digital solutions, with 86% of acquisitions and 98% of financial transactions being digital.

trajectory.text: Annual revenue grew from ₹ 336,367 Cr in FY25 to ₹ 348,615 Cr in FY26.
Net profit increased from ₹ 73,440 Cr in FY25 to ₹ 79,219 Cr in FY26.
Quarterly revenue grew by 9.4% year on year in Sep 2026.

balance_sheet.text: Deposits rose to ₹ 3,324,146 Cr in Sep 2026.
Borrowings increased to ₹ 594,144 Cr in Sep 2026.
Shareholders' equity reached ₹ 603,469 Cr in Sep 2026.

cash_quality.text: Cumulative cash from operations is 89% of cumulative net profit over FY22–FY26.

guidance.statement: We expect to see strong momentum in retail deposits.
guidance.quote: You will start the momentum coming about very well.

guidance.statement: Margins are expected to improve from Q3 FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.

guidance.statement: We will manage our liabilities to improve LCR ratios.
guidance.quote: You will see a kind of a thought process in the near future from Anup and team on what they are planning to do in improving core liability momentum.

guidance.statement: We aim to enhance our customer-facing roles while reducing back-end staff.
guidance.quote: We believe there would be a kind of a mix change in our employee composition.

guidance.statement: We do see credit demand holding.
guidance.quote: We do see credit demand holding. We do see a lot of resilience which has been there in the economy.

guidance.statement: We are well positioned across most of our business segments.
guidance.quote: We are well positioned across most of our business segments in terms of how we have approached them.

guidance.statement: We hope to see a fair amount of change in the acquisition numbers.
guidance.quote: I think we are now ready to press the pedal. I think that is what the entire franchise is driving about.

guidance.statement: We do think that the profit growth should be at or above the balance sheet growth.
guidance.quote: Yes, that's still in our plans and that's how we approach.

guidance.statement: We will be a significant portion of the system.
guidance.quote: Let it start to flow and you will see it. But definitely if the system is X, we will be a significant portion of the system.

guidance.statement: We are on track towards that.
guidance.quote: I think we are all, you know, the entire team is quite gung-ho to mobilize that kind of we're all energized.

guidance.statement: We will continue to focus on all these areas that I covered earlier.
guidance.quote: We will continue to focus on all these areas that I covered earlier.

guidance.statement: We will continue to have a good momentum and trajectory in our growth.
guidance.quote: We will continue to have a good momentum and trajectory in our growth.

guidance.statement: We expect to grow our business banking at about 20% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: We have grown our business banking, which is mainly representative of our MSME, we've grown at about 20% year-on-year.

guidance.statement: We intend to operate LCR between 110% and 120%.
guidance.quote: Our endeavor for LCR is to be between 110% and 120%.

guidance.statement: We will continue to improve our quality of deposit franchise over the years to come.
guidance.quote: The bank will continue to improve its quality of deposit franchise over the years to come.

guidance.statement: We expect significant benefits from operating leverage in the coming years.
guidance.quote: You should see operating leverage kicking in and enhancing your ROAs.

guidance.statement: The bank is on path to a growth trajectory similar to pre-merger levels.
guidance.quote: I think you will see the kind of growth that we have used to pre-merger coming back.

guidance.statement: Technology will be a differentiator for the bank in the coming years.
guidance.quote: Technology is going to be differentiator, and you will see it more happening over the year and two.

guidance.statement: The bank will commit to its operational performance as previously stated.
guidance.quote: None of that changes and the bank will commit to do whatever it has said in its calls that it would do.

guidance.question: How does management plan to address the declining ROE and negative operating margins?
guidance.answer: Management plans to improve margins starting Q3 FY27 and aims to enhance customer-facing roles while reducing back-end staff. They also expect significant benefits from operating leverage in the coming years.

verdict.headline: HDFC Bank shows revenue growth but struggles with operating margins and ROE decline.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of growth and resilience is supported by a 9.4% increase in quarterly revenue and rising deposits. However, the negative operating margins and declining ROE indicate challenges in operational efficiency.

bull.text: Quarterly revenue grew by 9.4% year on year in Sep 2026, indicating strong business momentum.
Deposits rose to ₹ 3,324,146 Cr in Sep 2026, showing strong customer trust and liquidity.
Net profit increased from ₹ 73,440 Cr in FY25 to ₹ 79,219 Cr in FY26, reflecting profitability growth.
